scope.history_cutoff: target Beijing date minus 3 days, strict prior 365 days, last 10 dated completed matches with a parsed formation

mapped_target_prior_formation_coverage.method_note: The target fixture formation is recorded only for leakage audit and is never used by model vectors.

features.formation_history: prior same Transfermarkt competition, target team ID, strict cutoff, prior 365d, at most 10 most recent games; Laplace smoothing (one pseudo-count in 4 categories); exact formation entropy is descriptive model input

methodology.model: standardized Ridge, fixed alpha=100, same target rows and Crown AH prices for market-only and market-plus-formation
methodology.AH: Crown historical T1 source-event line and both decimal prices; quarter-lines split into equal legs; 1U unit; no external bookmaker prices
methodology.policies: always choose the higher model EV side; separate research-only abstention variant bets only when the model EV is positive
methodology.information_boundary: target formation and lineup are ignored; model features use only prior dated matches strictly before target Beijing date minus 3 days; target FT is label only
methodology.live_limit: Transfermarkt is a retrospective bulk file without formation first-publication/receipt timestamps; receipt FID overlap is not prospective validation

target_history_coverage.method_note: The target fixture formation is recorded only for leakage audit and is never used by model vectors.

paired_model_diagnostics.scope_note: Metrics include the 2024-2026 out-of-frozen sample and are diagnostic; they do not select a production threshold.
